summary: The trace reveals a supply-chain coverage variant not covered by existing B1-B5 patterns. This 'legacy/ratio-based' variant uses a Ratio sheet for load size, formula cells in incoming shipments, and output columns (Rounding_Applied, Earliest_Scheduled_Inbound_Date) absent from existing scripts. The agent wrote ad-hoc code and failed the verifier. I'm adding this as variant B6 to the existing skill with a dedicated script and clear decision rules for when to use it versus the existing variants.
